transport_authentication.production_input: AuthenticatedDatagram supplied by a secure transport adapter
transport_authentication.identity: packet attestation identity must equal the resolved configured member and source IP
transport_authentication.port: source port must exactly equal configured backup port
transport_authentication.replay: sequence must strictly increase within a session; session must not decrease; newer session retires older session
transport_authentication.legacy_udp: SystemUdpSocket yields only Unauthenticated packets and BackupService legacy Java mode is non-producing
transport_authentication.payload: authenticated transport preserves exact 0x05 || protocol.BackupMessage bytes

seams.C020: secure P2P/network adapter supplies packet identity and session/sequence attestation
seams.C028: production lifecycle requires that adapter and forbids silent plain-UDP fallback

election: INIT yields to any MASTER flag or strictly higher priority
SLAVER timeout moves to INIT and resets timeout origin
MASTER yields only to a peer MASTER with higher priority, or equal priority when local textual IP is lexicographically smaller
SLAVER sends no keepalive; INIT sends flag=false; MASTER sends flag=true
lifecycle: server starts only for a nonzero port and a nonempty configured member list
only resolved allowlisted member IPs can affect election
DNS failures retain the last successfully resolved address set
unexpected socket failure rebinds until cancellation
close cancels and joins the event loop; a closed service can restart
